theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenVar_lusin_closed_subset_continuousOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn N) (A : Set (Rn N)), Measurable f → MeasurableSet A → μ A ≠ ∞ → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ C ⊆ A, IsClosed C ∧ μ (A \ C) < ε ∧ ContinuousOn f C
